struck: Index entries reach back to about 1980 by book and page.
use: The index lists names and dates from late 1979, starting at Deed Book 660. Older deed books show only by book and page, marked non-indexed.

struck: Escrow account holders can view, print and save documents online for $0.50 a page.
use: (cut it: the escrow page names an older system, and the live search says the county does not show images online)

struck: Horry County recorded 30,339 deeds, about 116 every weekday.
use: Horry County recorded 30,339 deeds in those 12 months, about 2,500 a month.

struck: MEMO: LOT 1238 TS DOGWOOD NECK SUB FARM AT CAROLINA FOREST
use: (cut it: it names one private lot, and the $580,000 came from a different entry; describe the memo as a short legal description, such as a lot number and a subdivision name)
By law the seller owes the deed fee, except on a master-in-equity or government deed, where the buyer owes it.

pattern: \bquitclaim\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:pays? no|no deed fee|exempt)\b|\b(?:pays? no|no deed fee|exempt)\b[^.]{0,80}\bquitclaim\b
struck: A corrective or quitclaim deed with no payment pays no deed fee.
use: A corrective or quitclaim deed that only confirms title the buyer already holds, with no payment, pays no deed fee.

struck: Many deeds show $0 because no money changed hands.
use: (cut "because": the index does not say why a price is blank. Say that many deeds show $0 or no price, and that state law exempts some estate, trust and correction deeds from the deed fee)

struck: Every deed recorded in Horry County comes with a sworn affidavit.
use: A deed is normally filed with a sworn affidavit of its value, or of the reason it is exempt.

struck: Recorded liens in the deed index include mechanics liens, condo liens, tax liens, child support liens and lis pendens.
use: The deed index also holds lis pendens notices, which say a lawsuit affects title to the property.

struck: Georgetown's index is usually a day behind.
use: Georgetown's index was current to the day before when we checked.

struck: In Georgetown County you can view and print every deed online.
use: Georgetown County lets you view and print a deed on its website when the image is available.
